item.title: ED Secures Sanction to Prosecute P Chidambaram Aircel-Maxis, INX Media Cases
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate on Thursday informed a Delhi special court that it has obtained mandatory government sanction to prosecute former Union Finance Minister P Chidambaram in the long-pending Aircel-Maxis and INX Media money laundering cases. item.description: India and the European Union have agreed to grant each other Most Favoured Nation (MFN) status for five years once their long-negotiated free trade agreement comes into force, according to a draft text released by the Union commerce ministry on Friday. item.title: On Nuclear Talks With Iran, Trump Says, "Big Decision to Make..."
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Friday said the United States faces a “big decision” in its ongoing Iran nuclear talks, describing Tehran as “very dangerous” and “very difficult” while maintaining that he prefers a peaceful resolution. The remarks came a day after the third round of negotiations between the United States and Iran concluded in Geneva on Thursday. Another round of discussions is scheduled to be held today as both sides continue diplomatic engagement amid heightened regional tensions.

item.title: IYC President Udai Bhanu Chib Gets Bail After Midnight Court Hearing
item.description: Indian Youth Congress president Udai Bhanu Chib was granted bail by a Duty Magistrate of Patiala House Court following a late-night hearing held at the judge’s residence. Chib was produced before the magistrate around 12:30 am after the completion of four days of police custody in connection with the AI Summit protest case. The hearing began around 1:30 am.
